MonitoringProgram.description:
Which monitoring programme produced an ecological measurement.

These are not interchangeable. CREMP uses fixed, permanently staked transects
with photo point counts. NCRMP uses stratified random sampling with linear
point intercept. A cover value from one is not a like-for-like substitute for
a cover value from the other, which is why the programme is a required field
on every measurement and travels to the dashboard rather than living in a note.

confidence weight of its own.

SiteScores.description:
Two scores, deliberately not blended into one.

ecological_value = 0.6 * normalized(coral_cover) + 0.4 * normalized(species_richness)
strategic_value  = 0.7 * ecological_value       + 0.3 * normalized(restoration_investment)

Restoration investment is a management consideration, not an ecological one.
Blending them into a single number quietly mixes two kinds of judgment.

The weights are stated prototype assumptions, not scientific claims, and are
labeled as such on the dashboard and in the pitch.

weights_are_prototype_assumptions.description: Always true. Present in the payload so the dashboard cannot forget to say so.
weights_are_prototype_assumptions.title: Weights Are Prototype Assumptions
